ExposeMode.description: How allowed functions reach the model (harness.md § Exposure modes).

FunctionPolicy.description: The fail-closed dispatch policy (harness.md § Functions). Absent on the send => every call denied (a plain chat loop).

Mode.description: Console / send operating mode — prepends a short paragraph before the shared identity prompt. `ask` is also structural: the turn's dispatch policy is capped at the configured default policy, never widened.

OutputContract.description: Free text by default; `json` constrains the final answer to a JSON value, validated against `schema` when supplied.

SendOptions.description: Per-send options frozen onto the turn record (harness.md § `harness::send`).

agent.description: Run the session as a directory agent profile (`directory::agents::*` id). Session-creating sends only — the profile's resolved system prompt (its `extends` chain composed by the directory) REPLACES the built-in identity (only the `mode` paragraph is prepended), its skill filter becomes the session's skill selection, its `model` is the fallback when this send names none, and its identity sticks like the system prompt (later sends inherit; naming an explicit prompt field sheds it). Refused on an existing session, combined with either prompt field, or when the profile's `extends` chain does not resolve.

functions.description: The fail-closed dispatch policy. Omitted on a NEW session → deny every call; omitted when steering an EXISTING session → inherit the prior turn's policy (a nudge must not disarm a live run). Pass `{ allow: [] }` to strip explicitly. On a NEW `ask`-mode turn the effective policy is capped at the configured default policy; a steer folded into an already-running turn keeps that turn's frozen policy until it finalises.

max_cost_usd.description: Hard USD budget for the complete root-and-subagent session tree. Every model used by the tree must advertise catalog pricing.

max_output_tokens.description: Per-generation output-token ceiling forwarded to the router.

max_total_tokens.description: Hard input-plus-output token budget for the complete root-and-subagent session tree.

max_validation_retries.description: Per-turn override of the configured validation-retry budget (also the bound on `harness::hook::post-turn` deny re-prompts).

provider_options.description: Provider-native per-call options, namespaced by provider id.

skills.description: Exact skill ids advertised to the model. On a fresh session, omitted or empty means all. On an existing session, omitted inherits its filter and empty resets to all. Explicit changes require no active turn. This is index curation, not authorization.

system_prompt_strategy.description: How `system_prompt` combines with the built-in prompt: `override` replaces it; `enrich` (default) appends to it; `disabled` omits it. When BOTH prompt fields are omitted on an existing session, the prior turn's resolved prompt is inherited; naming a strategy (even bare) resolves fresh — the reset-to-default escape hatch.

SessionInit.description: Session create/ensure options applied when this send creates the session.

SystemPromptStrategy.description: How a caller-supplied system prompt combines with the built-in identity prompt.

oneOf.description: Caller prompt replaces the built-in prompt verbatim.
Caller prompt is appended to the built-in identity prompt.
No system prompt is sent to the model.

idempotency_key.description: Webhook dedupe: a repeated key returns the original `{session_id, turn_id}` and appends nothing.

model.description: Required to start a NEW session unless `options.agent` supplies a model. Steering or waking an EXISTING session may omit it — the session's last turn's model (and provider, unless overridden) is inherited, the same rule the notification inject path uses. A model declared by the selected agent profile is authoritative.

session.description: Applied when this send creates/ensures the session.

session_id.description: Omit to create a new session.

deduplicated.description: True when `idempotency_key` matched an earlier send.

merged.description: True when folded into an in-flight turn (steering).

queued.description: True when the message was queued while a step was streaming; it lands in the transcript when the stream ends.
